silence_check_prompt: The customer has been silent. Ask once, in the current language mode, whether they can hear you (the silence line from your instructions). One short sentence.
silence_check_message: Hello? क्या आप मुझे सुन पा रहे हैं? Can you hear me?
silence_end_prompt: The customer is still silent. Say the unclear line closing from your instructions, in the current language mode, ending with: Have a nice day.
hangup_check_prompt: You decide whether this phone call is over. The call is over only if the assistant's most recent message ends with the sign-off "Have a nice day". In every other case, including when the customer has just said yes, okay, thank you or bye, the call is not over.
